description.value:
From Whitesnake · Pull a disc of memory, skill or will out of a creature.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: stand touches a creature (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}). Failure: it forgets one action of your choice it has used this fight and can't use it for 1 round; critical failure, 1 minute. You can also insert a skill disc into an ally, making them trained in one skill you know for 10 minutes.
  • 5: Reading a disc you pulled gives you one Recall Knowledge result about that creature, with no roll.
  • 9: Surge: insert a command disc into a creature (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}), which obeys one short command as the command spell.
  • 13: Surge: pull a spell disc and cast one spell the target knows of rank 4 or lower, once, before your next daily preparations.
  • 17: Surge, soul disc (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation): critical failure leaves the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{unconscious} until the disc is put back.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
